investigation.title: Remote Agents: Swarm Gateway 502 Blocking All Agent Provisioning Evals (production-api)
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents feature checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-10-11T01:10–01:11Z with an identical 502 bad_gateway error indicating the swarm provisioning gateway — an AWS ELB in us-east-2 — was unreachable when the eval runner issued POST /api/agents. Because the failure occurred before any agent was created, zero required evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was collected, and all contract assertions remain unverifiable. This is an eval-detected infrastructure signal; no user-traffic or incident data is present in the packet to confirm a broader production outage.
investigation.rootCause: The swarm provisioning gateway (an AWS ELB endpoint in us-east-2 fronting /v1/agents) was unreachable at the time of the eval run. The production-api layer returned HTTP 502 with code "bad_gateway" and the message "swarm gateway unreachable during agent provisioning: error sending request for url (http://[REDACTED].elb.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/v1/agents)" for every POST /api/agents call. Because all three sibling checks share the same failure message and all produced empty evidence objects, the failure is localized to the shared upstream swarm gateway dependency, not to any individual check's logic or eval runner code.
